events.title: Small hotfix (Version 1.6)
events.summary: Helloooooo! Halloween is almost here and to celebrate this event, we are releasing a hotfix for the demo. Enjoy! Patch notes: Some minor gameplay improvements; Several minor bugs fixed; Totally reworked the secret ending, now it’s kinda easier to get (but still this is a very SECRET ending so keep your eyes peeled!). That's it. Happy Halloween everyone and may the ghosts be with you! 👻

events.title: DEMO 1.5
events.summary: Fixed some minor bugs; Slightly reworked a staircase puzzle to make it a little less confusing and more intuitive.
